notes: Scorching Dragonfire, printed: 'deals 3 damage to target creature or planeswalker. If that creature or planeswalker would die this turn, exile it instead.' The 4/4 target survives the 3 damage; later the same turn another source deals it 1 more and it would die: it is exiled instead, never in its owner's graveyard. The spell itself goes to its owner's graveyard. No damage stays marked on the exiled card.
